journey.name: spark connection details
journey.description:
Lightning Connections lists Spark last under OPEN CONNECTIONS, after any open channel, as "Spark via Breez" with a channel bar whose receiving side reads "no limit". Its detail screen shows the same bar, then STATUS ("Connection open" in green while Spark is connected, "Connecting..." in yellow, "Offline..." in red), PROVIDER (Spark operators, the regtest deposit address, the trust paragraph), BALANCE (receiving capacity "no limit", spending balance) and DEPOSITS, one group per deposit: its transaction, amount, and the claim fee once claimed or the confirmations until then. The footer holds "Transfer To Savings" and, while Spark holds funds or a force transfer runs, "Force Transfer To Savings". Spark's row shows once Spark is connected, so "Connecting..." and "Offline..." are covered by unit tests and the PR's screenshots, not here. While Spark cannot receive (not connected, or a force transfer running) the bar shows only the spending side and the "Receiving capacity" row is hidden; an unclaimed deposit whose confirmations are unknown reads "Pending" under Status. A zero balance draws an empty grey spending track.
Precondition: Debug build on regtest with Spark connected on its regtest (journeys/README.md capabilities), no Lightning channel, and a claimed Spark deposit (fund the deposit address from Lightspark's regtest faucet and wait for 3 confirmations). Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (id "HeaderMenu"), Settings (id "DrawerSettings"), the Advanced tab (id "Tab-advanced") and Lightning Connections (id "Channels")
Verify the header's receiving reads "no limit" and OPEN CONNECTIONS lists "Spark via Breez" (id "SparkConnection") with its bar's receiving side reading "no limit", and no separate SPARK section
Tap "Spark via Breez" and verify the title "Spark via Breez" and the same bar at the top
Verify STATUS shows "Connection open" in green (id "SparkStatus")
Verify PROVIDER shows "Spark" with "Lightspark, Breez and Flashnet", the deposit address (id "SparkDepositAddress") and the paragraph starting "Your spending balance uses Spark"
Verify BALANCE shows "Receiving capacity" with "no limit" and "Spending balance" with the Spark balance
Verify DEPOSITS shows "Deposit tx" with the shortened transaction id (id "SparkDeposit"), "Deposit" with its amount and "Claim fee"
Verify the footer shows "Transfer To Savings" (id "SparkTransferToSavings") enabled and "Force Transfer To Savings" (id "SparkEmergencyExit") with a warning icon under it
Tap "Deposit tx" and verify the block explorer opens on that transaction
